title: sorbus domestica var. pomifera
intro: Sorbus domestica var. pomifera, commonly known as the edible rowan or mountain ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree species native to Europe and Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal and nutritional properties, and is rich in health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress, inflammation, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Sorbus domestica var. pomifera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-cancer, cardiovascular protective, and immune-modulatory effects. The plant's berries, leaves, and bark have been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various ailments, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, making it a valuable resource for natural health remedies.
